Ava (Marketing): Need final signoff on the Mistral case + 30s testimonial clip. Target promo + webinar tie-in. Can we lock creative and lead routing by EOD tomorrow?
Ben (Growth): Webinar date is 2026-08-12 15:00 UTC. Promo live 2026-08-04. Need SFDC campaign + HubSpot nurture. 30s org, 15s ad, 6s bumper.
Rina (CS): Customer draft contains a contract reference and an internal cluster name. Legal needs to clear or customer to sign a sanitized release.
Tao (Legal): We can’t publish contract numbers or internal infra names. Request a signed simplified release. If not signed, we'll redact those strings.
Ava (Marketing): Rina please send the sanitized quote and a quick DocuSign for logo + quote consent. Creative brief: 4s logo, 21s quote, 5s CTA, burned EN subs. Lower third: "Mistral  VP Eng, Lena Kor"
Rina (CS): DocuSign sent with checkbox for logo + quote + webinar appearance. ETA 8 hours. Pushed the edited quote replacing cluster name with "our platform."
Ben (Growth): OpsBot, create draft campaign and HubSpot workflow for Mistral_Case_EU_2026. Attach UTM template utm_campaign=mistral_case_eu.
OpsBot: Draft SFDC campaign created: "Mistral_Case_EU_2026". HubSpot workflow: "Mistral_Nurture_5d". Use /ops finalize to activate.
Rina (CS): Customer signed the release and approved the sanitized quote: "Moving to Redwood Dedicated reduced our inference spend by ~38% and sped up tail latency, letting us ship faster.  Lena Kor, VP Eng, Mistral."
Tao (Legal): Language approved, no PII. :thumbsup: Embargo ok if assets and signed release are in place.
Ava (Marketing): Great. Schedule: promo 2026-08-04T09:00Z, blog + webinar register same day, embargoed case PDF release 2026-08-12T14:00Z. Ben, confirm budget owner and boost window.
Ben (Growth): Budget owner growth@redwood.com. Boost 8/04-8/11. I'll attach audience specs when creatives are exported.
Ava (Marketing): OpsBot please run pre-publish checklist when assets are uploaded: render master, export 30/15/6, burn subs EN, CDN upload, SFDC finalize, HubSpot enable, blog schedule, social copy.
OpsBot: Checklist queued. Files to create on upload: mistral_master.mov, mistral_30s.mp4, mistral_15s.mp4, mistral_6s.mp4, en.srt, s3://redwood-marketing/mistral/.
Ava (Marketing): Final review slot 2026-08-04 08:00Z. Please mark calendars. Closing thread  post final asset links here. :rocket:
